final: WITH group_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS rate FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM group_rates) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(g.rate - b.rate) AS average_margin_above_benchmark FROM group_rates AS g CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE g.rate > b.rate
